name: Phase Autopilot
description: Opt-in per-task `autoRun` ("Run through") flag that auto-starts the next phase when a phase session finishes. startTaskPhase records `boundTask {id, phase}` on the spawned SavedSession (sessionTypes.ts). mcp-core notify-server now includes the sender's sessionId in notifications; NotifyServer (notifications.ts) fires onNotify, exposed by SessionManager.onNotify. registerAutopilot (commands/taskFlow.ts) maps the event to the bound task, re-reads it from the task-store and asks the pure decideNextPhase (phaseAutopilot.ts) for {start} or {stop: reason}. Stops: autorun off, needs_input, task done/phase cleared, phase unchanged after done (blocked), or next phase is fix with open high-priority review-finding subtasks. One verdict per session on 'done'; a live session already bound to the same task+phase blocks a double-start. UI: "Run through" checkbox + "autopilot" chip on Phase Board cards and in TaskDetailPane's PhaseStepper, writing autoRun via the normal update RPC. autoRun is serialized in task frontmatter only when true.
guidelines: Decision logic stays in the pure decideNextPhase; keep I/O in registerAutopilot.
Autopilot starts phases only through startTaskPhase so manual and automatic starts share one path.
`task.phase` names the NEXT phase; 'unchanged after done' means task.phase === the session's bound phase.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-start past a high-priority review finding or a needs_input stop.
Do not trigger from notifications without a sessionId or a boundTask.
